content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Foreign Languages Centre Language modules English English At HTW Berlin you can choose between modules with a study programme-related focus in which you learn specialist terminology general language modules to prepare you for language certificate examinations You can also take a range of different language certificate examinations at HTW Berlin. Table of contents UNIcert® II Certificates TOEIC L&R TOEFL (no course in WS 25/26) Head of Language Team - English Deputy Manager Lecturers (Kopie 1) (Kopie 3) Associate Lecturer (Kopie 5) (Kopie 7) (Kopie 8) (Kopie 9) (Kopie 10) (Kopie 11) (Kopie 12) (Kopie 13) (Kopie 14) (Kopie 15) (Kopie 16) (Kopie 17) (Kopie 18) (Kopie 19) (Kopie 20) (Kopie 21) (Kopie 22) (Kopie 24) (Kopie 25) (Kopie 26) (Kopie 27) (Kopie 29) (Kopie 30) (Kopie 31) UNIcert® II Requirements: Regular attendance in all courses (at least 80%) Achievement of certificate levels M2 and M3 Scope: 8 weekly study hours Examination: Cumulative model Grading: The final grade is calculated from the average of all individual grades, which are equally weighted Certificates At the Foreign Languages Centre you can prepare for the internationally recognised English certificates TOEFL (no course in WS 25/26) and TOEIC L&R. All preparatory courses — regardless of the certificate examination — culminate with a university-internal module certificate. This module certificate can help you when applying to the International Office for a semester abroad in an English-speaking country. TOEIC L&R Target group: Primarily students wishing to study abroad in an English-speaking country Scope: 1× 2 weekly study hours (34 hours) Examination: The examination can be taken 2× year at HTW Berlin. TOEFL (no course in WS 25/26) Target group: Students wishing to study in the USA, Canada or Japan Scope: 1× 4 weekly study hours or 68 intensive hours Examination: Only a preparatory course can be taken at HTW Berlin. The examination is subject to fees and can only be taken at authorised institutions. During the course students acquire the skills and abilities required for the examination.
